steps.headline: Does the card grouping now fit YouCoded?
steps.changed: Project and plugin use the app's existing collapsible-card arrangement: each has a shared header and an inset body. Individual skills and the server are separate setting cards inside the plugin, with even padding on both sides.
steps.notice: Collapse the plugin while the project remains open, then open Personal and compare its contents. The plugin's switch stays separate from its expand button.
steps.risk: UI-only prototype using sample names; this is not the full Projects page and these switches do not save. This round is only about grouping, collapsing and styling.
